preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 30.
Each test case integer N must be between 2 and 1000.
The sum of all N across test cases must not exceed 1000.

postconditions.description: The output permutation A must have a length equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= N for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: All elements in the permutation A must be integers between 1 and N.
The permutation A must contain all distinct integers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(median(A[:i]) != median(A[:i+1]) for i in range(1, N))
postconditions.description: For every 1 ≤ i < N, the median of the prefix of length i must not equal the median of the prefix of length i+1.
